spans.s: --a grandson of नन्दियश; ruled at पूरिका. Br. III. ७४. १८३.
(I)--Mt. on the base of Meru, and on the south of the मानस. भा. V. १६. २६; Br. II. १४. ३८; १९. १५; वा. ३६. २२; ३८. 2; Vi.
(III)--a son of मेधातिथि and the founder of the शिशिरम् kingdom in प्लक्षद्वीप. Br. II. १४. ३६-8; वा. ३३. ३२; Vi.
(IV)--a क्षत्रिय who became a dvija. Br. III. ६६. ८८.
(VIII)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा in the १६थ् Kalpa. वा. २१. ३५. [page३-431+ २६]
(IX)--the winter; the first of ऋतुस्. वा. ५३. २६, ११३.
--one of Vasudeva's wives and mother of four sons. Br. III. ७१. १८३.
(II)--a son of सारण. वा. ९६. १६४; Vi. IV. १५. २१.
--the आन्ध्र king who vanquished शुशर्मा, the कण्व: ruled for २३ years. M. २७३. 2.
--a grandson of नन्दियश, ruled in पुरीका. वा. ९९. ३७०. [page३-435+ ३०]

--succeeded Nandivardhana eclipsing the fame of all his predecessors and became ruler of Girivraja; killed the Pradyotas and became king at वाराणसी; esta- blished his son at Benares; ruled for ४० years; suc- ceeded by काकवर्ण, क्षेमधर्मा, क्षेमजित्, Vin- dhyasena, भूमिपुत्र, अजातशत्रु, वम्शक, उदासि, Nandivardhana and महानन्दि; all of them ruled for ३६० years; their contemporaries are इक्ष्वाकुस्, पाञ्चलस्, [page३-432+ ३७] काशेयस्, Haihayas, Kalingas, अश्मकस्, Kurus, Maithilas, शूरसेनस् and वीतिहोत्रस्. M. २७२. 6-१७; वा. ९९. ३१४-15.
--the father of काकवर्ण; became ruler after rooting out the Pradyotas; ruled for ४० years at Benares. भा.

--ten in number commencing with शिशुनाग, and ending with महानन्दि; these ruled for ३६० years.
1: भा.

; Br. III. ७४. १२७-35.
These are क्षत्रबन्धुस् and contemporaries of इक्ष्वाकुस्, पाञ्चलस्, कालकस्, Haihayas, Ekalingas, शकस्, Kuravas, Maithilas, सूरसेनस्, वीतिहोत्रस्.^2 (See also शिशुनाक).

--a son of श्रुतश्रवस् and दमघोष; in pre- vious births, हिरण्यकशिपु killed by Narasimha and रावण (दशग्रीव) killed by राम; a hater of Hari but was shown grace by कृष्ण;
1: भा. IX. २४. ४०;

. १७; X. ६०. १८; २९. १३; Br. ७१. १५८-59; वा. ९६. १५७-58.
attacked the northern gate of मथुरा and Gomanta when they were besieged by जरासन्ध;
2: भा. X. ५०. ११ [7]; ५२. ११ [१५].
engaged by भीष्मक for his daughter रुक्मिणी under the influence of Rukmin, his eldest son; defeated by कृष्ण who carried off रुक्मिणी; consoled by his friends that Time was not in his favour he returned to his city.
3: Ib. X. ५३ (whole); ५४. 9-१७; Vi. V. २६. 3 and 7.
Protested against the place of honour being given to कृष्ण when ब्रह्मऋषिस् and राजऋषिस् were available. He vilified him as a cowherd given to drinking and not an observer of वर्णधर्म. While the पाण्डवस् drew their swords, कृष्ण cut off his head.
4: Ib. X. ७४ (whole).
His [page३-433+ ३५] friend was शाल्व who summoned a conference at कुण्डिन to which शिशुपाल went.
5: Ib. X. ५७. १९; ७६. 2 [१०]; ७८. [5]; Vi. IV. १४. ४५. ५२.
As he died remembering the Lord, he attained मोक्ष;
6: भा. VII. १०. ३८;

. ४८; Br. IV. २९. १२२.
(see Caidya). Maitreya asked पराशर how it was that though he was killed by the Lords Nara- simha and राम, हिरण्यकशिपु did not attain salvation but was reborn as शिसुपाल, and how he attained it when killed by कृष्ण; पराशर replied that neither हिरण्यकशिपु nor रावण knew that Narasimha or राम were the अवतार्स् of विष्णु; शिशुपाल knew in his heart of hearts that कृष्ण was God विष्णु and welcomed death at his hands. Hence his salvation.
7: Vi. IV. १
(I)--a प्रजापति; father of Bhrami and father-in-law of Dhruva. भा. IV. १०. ११.

(II)--the form of the system of heavenly bodies supposed to be yoga power of Hari. At the end of the tail is Dhruva and on the tail are other gods like Indra, Agni, कश्यप; on its back lies the अजवीथि and on the stomach the Ganges. Similarly all constellations and planets are seen on the different limbs of its body;
1: भा.

(III)--is तारामय; the eternal deity; उत्ता- नपाद is the upper jaw, यज्ञ is the lower lip, Dharma is the head, heart is नारायण, साध्य and अश्विन्स् front feet, वरुण and Aryama is the hind feet, the samvatsara, child; Mitra is अपान; tail is Agni, Mahendra, मरीचि and कश्यप and Dhruva; all the planets are centred in Dhruva. वा. ५२. ९०-9; Vi.
--in the third tala or Vitala. वा. ५०. २६.
--an Asura with a city in the third Talam. Br. II. २०. २७.
--a son of Dhruva and धन्या; married सुच्छाया daughter of Agni.

--also designated शन्त and साधुस्; those who have conquered the senses; साधु brahmaca1ri, साधु gr2hasta, साधु vaikha1nasa and साधु yati by yoga practice; followers of स्मार्त and श्रौत karmas; put in practice आचार which is eightfold; जितात्मन्स्। Br. II. ३२. १९-53; ३५. १९२.

--characteristics of; eight limbs are gifts, truth, tapas, non-covetousness, learning, sacrifice, honour and modesty (giving birth to a son and sympathy-वा। प्।). Prac- tised by seven sages; the features of the above eight limbs; the शिष्टस् are Manu and the seven sages who promulgate laws relating to त्रयी, वार्ता and दण्डनीति, इज्या and Var- णाश्रम; the आचारस् are besides the two-fold श्रौत and स्मार्त dharma. Br. II. ३२. ३६; ३५. १९२;
--a son of Dhruva; wife सुच्छाया; Ripu and four other sons. Vi. I. १३. 1.
